company.shortDescription: David AI supplies audio datasets and associated services for speech, multilingual, and conversational AI applications.
company.description: David AI supplies audio datasets and associated services for speech, multilingual, and conversational AI applications. Its product offerings include off-the-shelf datasets such as Converse (natural two-speaker English conversations), Atlas (multilingual, accented, and dialect-rich), Chorus (multi-speaker dialogues), and Dialog (expert domain conversations). The company also collaborates with clients to design custom data collection, labeling, and metadata pipelines to support specialized audio model training.

productsAndServices.description: A platform for collecting and managing large-scale, high-quality audio datasets to support training of audio AI models.
